target_subject: three people standing near commercial ovens in a kitchen

scene: A tiled-floor commercial kitchen with stainless-steel equipment, including two large CINELLI-ESPERIA ovens and metal shelving units.
The left side shows a meat grinder and brown-tiled wall; the right side features an open oven door revealing trays of baked goods.
Red toolboxes sit on a wooden pallet beneath the central oven; overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the space.
action: A man in a white t-shirt and striped pants stands facing two others, gesturing with his right hand toward the oven area.
A woman with dark curly hair in a white blouse stands with her body angled toward the man, observing the oven.
A man wearing glasses and a light blue sweater stands partially behind the woman, looking toward the ovens.
rationale: The man’s open hand and orientation suggest he is explaining or demonstrating something about the oven operation.
The woman’s posture and gaze direction indicate attention to the man or the oven, though her exact focus is ambiguous due to partial occlusion.
The presence of multiple ovens with visible baked items implies active food production, but no baking action is currently visible.
object: A three-tiered stainless-steel convection oven branded 'CINELLI-ESPERIA' has illuminated interior lights and contains trays of golden-brown baked goods on at least two levels.
A second single-door stainless-steel oven to the right also bears the 'CINELLI-ESPERIA CORPORATION' logo and displays a lit interior with stacked trays, one of which holds a rectangular white dish.
A red toolbox with yellow-handled tools rests on a wooden pallet directly under the central oven.
A stainless-steel meat grinder with a white plastic hopper sits on the far left, adjacent to a brown-tiled wall section.

Three individuals are present: a woman in a white long-sleeve shirt and dark pants, a man in a light blue sweater and dark trousers, and a man in a white t-shirt and black-and-white striped chef pants.
